name: Ab Wheel Rollout
steps: Kneel on the floor holding the ab wheel handles directly beneath your shoulders with straight arms.
Tuck your pelvis slightly, brace your abs tightly, and squeeze your glutes to lock your spine neutral.
Roll the wheel slowly forward while letting your hips and shoulders move together as far as you can hold a flat lower back.
Press downward through the handles and contract your abs and lats to pull the wheel smoothly back beneath your shoulders.
tips: Stop the rollout immediately before your lower back begins to arch or sag.
Keep your arms straight throughout rather than bending your elbows to assist the return.
